newsitem.title: USA: Skyline oks exchange offer for warrants.
newsitem.headline: Skyline oks exchange offer for warrants.

text.p: Skyline Multimedia Entertainment Inc said Wednesday it approved an exchange offer for all outstanding class A and class B warrants.

The company said it will offer to exchange one newly issued share of its common stock for four outstanding class A warrants and one newly issued share of its common stock for eight outstanding Class B Warrants.
The exchange offer will be conditioned on, among other things, minimum tender by the holders of at least 75 percent of outstanding warrants of each class.
If the company receives tenders for the minimum number of warrants according to the exchange offer, there will be about 540,000 additional shares of common stock outstanding.
If the company receives tenders for all outstanding warrants, there will be a total of about 720,000 additional shares of common stock outstanding.
The company said that based on the trading history of its common stock, the warrants have never been and are not currently "in-the-money."
As of July 1, the closing bid and last sale prices of the common stock and class A and B warrants were $2.875 and $3.375, $0.562 and $0.625, $0.25 and $0.312, respectively.
The warrants expire by their terms on Feb. 13, 1999, unless earlier redeemed.
The company also said it executed a non-binding letter of intent with Cowen & Co to raise about $10 million through the private placement of debt or equity securities.
The company said it expects to use the proceeds of the private placement for the continued development of its current projects.
